summary: Frontend was updated to fetch real provider results via a new React Query hook and to display engagement status on each provider card. However, the diff summary does not provide evidence that the backend exposes the required new/extended provider-browsing query API with correct engagement-time logic and authorization, and the provider-results empty-state behavior is not fully evidenced due to truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add/extend a backend query API that returns a list of provider profiles suitable for client browsing (including each provider’s current engagement state), and ensure it is callable by authenticated clients.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff snippet only shows type definitions and imports; it does not show any new/updated public query method that returns an array of ProviderProfileView for browsing/filtering, nor logic to force isEngaged=false when engagementEndTime is in the past, nor authorization checks.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no provider-results query method shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: If there are genuinely zero providers for the filter, the UI shows an empty-state that indicates there are no providers for that category (not a placeholder message implying search is not implemented).
missing_requirements.reason: ProviderResultsPage shows loading skeletons and a providers count, but the diff is truncated before any explicit zero-results empty-state UI/message can be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: If the backend call fails, the page shows a clear English error message and a retry action.
missing_requirements.reason: ProviderResultsPage imports AlertCircle and destructures isError/error/refetch, and the file summary claims error handling with retry, but the truncated diff does not show the rendered error state UI and retry control.

hallucinated_features.description: Added verification status badges (Verified/Pending/Rejected/Unverified) and rating display elements on provider cards beyond the requested engagement status indicator.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-98 only asks to show engagement status (Engaged / Not Engaged/Available) on provider cards; the diff adds/contains additional visible badge logic and a star rating display that are not part of the stated requirements for this change.
